photos.localAssets: benchmarks/cache/v02/corpus (gitignored; individual licenses retained in source ledger)

maps.annotationMethod: Freeciv renderer sprite/source-alpha transform and saved-state negative evidence; no model annotations
limitations: All seven positive selected Explorer bodies share the same screen coordinate; background variation is not positional diversity

ui.annotationMethod: AT-SPI exact widget allocations, independently corroborated painted edges and complete scoped toolbar inventory
limitations: Controlled actual applications, one source family per split; no natural-user-capture diversity claim

splitRules: Exclude every previously exposed image ID, image SHA256 and source author/group.
A source group belongs to exactly one split; source URL alone is not sufficient grouping.
Freeze image bytes, annotations, manifests, routes, representation parameters and prompts before heldout execution.
Producer requests contain pixels or candidate encoding plus semantic target/classes only, never IDs, filenames, source provenance, split or truth.
Evaluator loads truth only after producer outputs are durably recorded.
No model-derived boxes/masks, unverified missing-class negatives or corpus-dependent color/position rules.
Changing algorithm after revealed heldout requires an unseen heldout for a new blind claim.

controlledSupplements.annotationMethod: model-assisted pixel review, no candidate/model outputs
limitations: one game and one app source group per stratum/split
Freeciv map exposes a small explored area; OpenTTD is one generated seed

qualificationScope: Independent controlled actual game/application strata are eligible under the accepted plan. A separate natural-user-capture quota is not required; report source-family and positional limits explicitly.
